exams.name: USA Cycling Coaching License
exams.blurb: Tiered coaching licence programme covering training physiology, race tactics, athlete safety and coaching ethics.

exams.name: USA Swimming Certified Official
exams.blurb: Rules testing and on-deck apprenticeship pathway certifying stroke and turn judges, starters and referees for sanctioned meets.

exams.name: USATF Official Certification
exams.blurb: Levelled certification for track and field officials based on rules examinations, apprenticeship and meet experience.

exams.name: USCCA Certified Instructor
exams.blurb: Instructor certification covering concealed carry law, defensive shooting fundamentals, range safety and course delivery.

exams.name: USPTA Tennis Professional Certification
exams.blurb: Certification pathway rating tennis teaching professionals on stroke demonstration, teaching skill and written rules testing.
